description: TRC-20 USDT settlement check by transaction id: did it land, is it irreversible, how much, from and to whom. When to use: an agent or a merchant must confirm a USDT payment before releasing value - this is the settlement check that closes an automated trade loop. Do not use: to assess the counterparty (that is tron_check_address_risk). Data source: our own java-tron full node when the transaction is inside its ~6 day retention window (sub-second, no third party); it falls back to TronGrid automatically for older transactions, and says which one answered in `source`. A local miss is never reported as 'not found' by itself. Returns: found, status (SUCCESS|FAILED), finalized (present on the solidity/irreversible chain), confirmations, blocks_until_finality, block_number, block_time_utc, amount_usdt, from, to, fee_trx, checks {}, verified and a plain-language verdict. Pass expected_to / expected_amount_usdt to have the recipient and amount matched for you. Metered: 5 free calls per day per IP, then 0.01 USDC per call over x402. There is no API key: the 402 answer carries the machine-readable terms in structuredContent.accepts[].

expected_amount_usdt.description: Optional: the USDT amount you expect

name: tron_verify_usdt_transfer
